APPROVE
The extracted helpers move about ten points of nested-`if` and boolean-operator complexity out of the method, so it should fall to 15 or below; the merged `||` condition short-circuits in the same order as the original checks, so behaviour is unchanged; and `entry` is definitely assigned after the `continue` guard, so it compiles cleanly. I couldn't find the source file on this machine, so this is based on the diff alone and assumes the rest of the moved code only uses `direct`, `resolved` and `lockPath`.
